chunks: My father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me from al-Husayn ibn al-Hasan ibn Aban, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the Ziyarah of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), he said: 'Once a year, for I dislike being widely known (or: being identified as a frequent visitor).'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended frequency for visiting the grave of Imam Husayn according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises that visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) once a year is sufficient, as he dislikes excessive publicity or being identified as a frequent visitor.
